image_location_description: Center of the figure: white chest/abdomen block with small dark V-neck hints

steps.title: Base footprint
steps.description: Join 2x white 2x3 plates (3021) side-by-side to make a 4x3 base.

steps.title: Front & back walls
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x4 bricks (3010) along front and back edges.

steps.title: Fill middle row
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x2 bricks (3004) to fill the center row.

steps.title: Second layer (outer)
steps.description: Stack 4x white 1x2 bricks (3004) to start the next layer perimeter.

steps.title: Second layer (fill)
steps.description: Fill remaining studs with 4x white 1x1 bricks (3005).

steps.title: Raised chest step
steps.description: Center 1x white 2x3 plate (3021) on top to create a tapered step.

steps.title: Collar + crease hint
steps.description: Add 1x white 2x2 tile (2420) + 1x black 1x2 grille tile (2412b) at front.

steps.title: Smooth side tops
steps.description: Add 2x white 2x2 tiles (2420) on left/right at the lower top level.

steps.title: Close remaining gaps
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x2 tiles (2458) to finish the top surface edges.

steps.title: V-neck point
steps.description: Add 1x black 1x1 round tile (98138) just below the collar line.
